rules.statement: The defendant, who was aware of the fraudulent intention to deprive the minor of his property and induced B not to register the deed, held the estate as a constructive trustee for John Rajapakse.
rules.supporting_quote: "I accordingly hold that the defendant was a trustee of the property for John Rajapakse, and that the Crown grants and Final Order on which he rests his title from the Grown were obtained by him as such trustee and do not give him a title which can prevail over the deed of gift."
